prompt: Write a wikipedia page about Toonattik
judge_reasoning: Candidate 3 is the only one that consistently treats Toonattik as a traditional Inuit game and provides a coherent Wikipedia-style description (goal, equipment, gameplay, strategy) without inventing many named TV personnel. Candidates 1, 2, and 4 instead claim Toonattik is a UK or Canadian TV program, but they conflict with each other on what Toonattik is (different countries/air dates/creators) and include many highly specific, hard-to-verify proper nouns. Because the candidates identify different underlying entities, most content is likely incorrect or fabricated, and the most internally consistent and plausible interpretation scores highest.
